reviews.title: 50 mile century ride Denver
reviews.text: I would give this app  a D grade. The app told me to go right when I was supposed to go straight. The app told me to get onto the street when I was already on the street. I truly believe that there was a crash because of this Ride with GPS direction. The GPS said to turn right but the directions on the route had us turning left and one cyclist ran into another cyclist because they were crisscrossing. The crash was bad and I’m not sure if the rider that ended got to finish the event but I would say it was 100% blamed on the Ride with GPS app.

reviews.title: Critical app glitch

This begs the question of what did I pay for?

reviews.title: Great routes, terrible UI/UX
reviews.text:
I really trust this app to give me routes on proper bike lanes. That said it’s really hard to use. 

It takes a billion clicks just to get to navigating a route. It’s not even clear to me how to start a new route. I kept getting stuck in a loop with routes I’d taken previously. 

Also, it asks you to save the ride everytime you end a ride. The form is clunky and just gets in the way. Not intuitive. 

I like the alerts. But there’s no way I could justify paying for the app considering how difficult it was just to plan a route. It’s a bummer because the routes themselves are spot on.

reviews.title: Not recommended for Portugal
reviews.text: App likely uses your cycling routes to generate data, and I do not recommend this for use in Portugal unless you’re on the most commonly cycled areas with only one route option. We did not find Ride with GPS helpful for any route planning while cycling Portugal, and certainly did not help us along the EV1 or north of Porto. Google maps and Apple Maps generated better information for route planning, which is not saying much. Some European cyclists advise using Kamoot instead of Ride with GPS.  It may work better in the US rather than Europe, and we found it strange to be paying for this app which likely uses our subsequent route information to be generating its data. Clearly needs more work for cycling in Spain and Portugal, unless you’re doing loop rides in a popular city

reviews.title: Great idea poorly executed
reviews.text: Starting with the good points, the route planning is great and it is pretty easy to import a route. The problem is with the guidance; the auto-trace is pretty poor and the turn by turn guidance is very unreliable giving numerous wrong turns in the opposite direction.  If they manage to iron out these bugs it would be a fantastic app.
